**Download** · **Scarica**: [`Owlook-Chrome.zip`](https://github.com/Owlook-quotes/owlook/releases/latest/download/Owlook-Chrome.zip) · <https://owlook-quotes.github.io/owlook/>

Works on / Funziona su: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Arc (computer). Not on Safari, Firefox or phones / Non su Safari, Firefox e telefoni.

**English**
1. Unzip `Owlook-Chrome.zip`: you get an `owlook` folder. Keep it where it is.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`, Brave: `brave://extensions`, Opera: `opera://extensions`) and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and choose the `owlook` folder.
4. Open any web page and press **Alt+Shift+M**, or click the Owlook icon.

Updating: copy the new files over the old `owlook` folder, press ⟳ on the Owlook card, reload your tabs. Lists and settings are kept.

**Italiano**
1. Scompatta `Owlook-Chrome.zip`: ottieni la cartella `owlook`. Lasciala dove si trova.
2. Apri `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`, Brave: `brave://extensions`, Opera: `opera://extensions`) e attiva **Modalità sviluppatore**.
3. Premi **Carica estensione non pacchettizzata** e scegli la cartella `owlook`.
4. Apri una pagina qualsiasi e premi **Alt+Maiusc+M**, oppure clicca l'icona di Owlook.

Aggiornare: copia i file nuovi sopra la vecchia cartella `owlook`, premi ⟳ sulla scheda di Owlook, ricarica le pagine. Liste e impostazioni restano.
